 Local Jack Bergman Wins Re-Election in Michigan’s 1st Congressional District
 Lisa Giles , Megan Huiskens 11-04-2026 at 03:14:36 AM EST Link Copied! LANSING - Republican incumbent Jack Bergman has won re-election to Michigan’s 1st Congressional District, defeating Democratic challenger Callie Barr. Bergman will return to Congress to continue representing a district that includes the Upper Peninsula and much of Northern Michigan.
 Bergman, a retired U.S. Marine Corps Lieutenant General, has represented the 1st District since 2017. Before entering Congress, he served 40 years in the Marine Corps, operated small businesses, and spent 22 years as a commercial airline pilot. He currently serves on the House Armed Services, Budget and Veterans’ Affairs committees.
 Bergman’s re-election extends his tenure representing Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula in Washington.
